takeaway: Give it weeks, and do not worry about one missed day.

decoys.fix: Habit time varies by person and act; there is no fixed day count.
One missed chance did not wipe out habit growth in the study.

takeaway: On average a loss weighs about twice a gain; estimates vary.
original: On average a loss weighs about twice a gain; people differ.

decoys.fix: Equal gain and loss can have a different felt weight.
The pattern does not fix how every person will feel.

takeaway: Even a random number can tug your guess toward it.
original: Even a made-up number can tug your guess toward it.

decoys.fix: A first number pulls a guess toward it, but the guess can differ from that number.
Even a number known to be random can sway a later guess.

takeaway: To test an idea, look for the case that could break it.

decoys.fix: One fitting case may fit more than one idea.
A case against an idea can test it well.

takeaway: What a crowd picks can pull your own pick.

decoys.fix: Group answers can pull some people in some settings.
Anyone can take a crowd's choice as a clue; it is not a sign of a weak person.

takeaway: Linking past tasks to a new plan can end too-short guesses.
original: Past tasks show how long the next one may take.

decoys.fix: Past task times can show steps a new plan has missed.

decoys.text: is pointless, since delays are flukes.
decoys.fix: Calling each past delay a fluke keeps it out of the next plan, so guesses stay short.

takeaway: Learn first; the memory firms up later.

decoys.fix: Sleep can help store what was learned, but it does not supply an unread lesson.
A new memory firms up over time after learning.

takeaway: Variable means the reward comes, but you cannot tell when.

decoys.fix: A good result can come after dull ones, with no set gap.
A reward after every fifth try is fixed; on a variable schedule, the number of tries keeps changing.

takeaway: A clear moment is easy to notice; a vague one is easy to miss.
pieces: a vague one is easy to miss.

decoys.text: a broad wish names the moment.
decoys.fix: A broad goal leaves the moment of action unnamed.

decoys.text: one named cue never hides chances.
decoys.fix: Focusing on one named cue can make other good chances easier to miss.

takeaway: Others usually judge our slips more kindly than we fear.

decoys.fix: Our own vivid view can make an event seem more visible to others than it was.

decoys.text: far more harshly than we fear.
decoys.fix: After a slip, people judged us more kindly than we expected.

takeaway: If prices grow faster than your money, you fall behind.

decoys.text: you can buy just as much.
decoys.fix: When broad prices rise, the same cash can buy fewer goods.
A raise smaller than the rise in prices still buys less than before.

takeaway: Gains you leave in start to earn gains too.

decoys.text: Only the sums you put in
decoys.fix: When gains stay in the pot, later gains can build on them too.
Compound growth includes gains on past gains as well as on the starting amount.

takeaway: Years to double is about 72 divided by the rate.

decoys.fix: The rule gives a rough guess, not an exact date.
Market gains can vary; the shortcut needs a steady assumed rate.

takeaway: A chance of more gain comes with bigger ups and downs.

decoys.fix: A high possible return can come with a loss too.
An uncertain asset can lose value as well as gain it.

takeaway: A real spread means many firms across many different industries.

decoys.fix: One firm or sector leaves a lot tied to one outcome.
Many firms in one industry still share the same risk.

takeaway: Each share is a slice; more shares means a bigger slice.

decoys.fix: A share is ownership, not a fixed loan payment.
Your slice depends on your shares out of all the shares.

takeaway: An RBI guide puts the fund in a separate savings account you can reach fast.
original: Keep it in a separate savings account you can reach fast.
pieces: An RBI guide puts the fund in

decoys.fix: Money tied up in a hard-to-sell asset may not be ready when an urgent bill arrives.

decoys.text: only if it pays the most.
decoys.fix: The guide puts the fund in an easy-to-reach savings account.

takeaway: A longer loan lowers each EMI but raises the total interest.

decoys.fix: A longer term can lower each payment but raise total interest.
A longer term can raise total interest even when the loan rate stays fixed.

takeaway: An index fund matches its index, up and down, minus a small gap.
pieces: matches its index, up and down,

decoys.fix: Tracking a market index also means sharing its falls.
Fees and running costs leave a small gap called tracking error.

takeaway: Your PIN approves payments. Receiving money never needs it.

decoys.fix: To get money, a person need not key in a UPI PIN.

decoys.text: requires a QR scan and PIN.
decoys.fix: A QR scan and UPI PIN can make a payment; getting money needs neither.
